reading.title: The Old Bike Race
reading.intro_zh: 这篇短文把 Lesson 56 的“旧机器、慢速度、故障喜剧、同样刺激”换到博物馆旧自行车赛：速度不快，但老车铃声、掉链子、少数选手完赛都让比赛很有趣。重点练习 once a year、race、entered、excitement、well-kept、take part、break down、course、rival 和 no less exciting。
passage: Once a year, our town museum holds a small race for old bicycles in the yard. Only old bicycles can take part. Last Sunday, twelve riders entered, and there was a great deal of excitement before the first bell rang. The most unusual bicycle was a well-kept tall black one built in 1902, with a tiny front lamp and a very hard seat. After a great many cheerful bells, the race began. Several bicycles broke down on the course, and one rider spent more time fixing a loose chain than riding. A few riders, however, completed the race. The winning bicycle reached only twelve miles an hour, a little faster than its tired rivals, but the race was no less exciting than a modern bike show. Everyone laughed and clapped because each old machine had finished like a hero.

questions.question: What kind of race did the museum hold?
options: A small race for old bicycles in the museum yard.
A modern motorcycle race on a city road.
A school running race for young children.
A fast car race with new sports cars.
questions.explanation_zh: 短文开头说 our town museum holds a small race for old bicycles in the yard，所以这是博物馆院子里的旧自行车赛。

questions.question: Which bicycle was the most unusual?
options: A new red bicycle with a loud horn.
A well-kept tall black bicycle built in 1902.
A tiny bicycle made for a small child.
A silver bicycle with no seat at all.
questions.explanation_zh: 短文说 The most unusual bicycle was a well-kept tall black one built in 1902，关键信息是 well-kept、tall black 和 built in 1902。

questions.question: What happened to several bicycles on the course?
options: They left the yard and entered a busy street.
They became much faster than modern racing bikes.
They broke down, and one rider had to fix a loose chain.
They stopped because the museum closed early.
questions.explanation_zh: 短文说 Several bicycles broke down on the course，而且一个 rider 花很多时间 fixing a loose chain。

questions.question: How fast did the winning bicycle go?
options: Two miles an hour.
Forty miles an hour.
One hundred miles an hour.
Twelve miles an hour.
questions.explanation_zh: 获胜自行车只达到 only twelve miles an hour，速度不快，但比 tired rivals 稍快。

questions.question: Why was the race still exciting?
options: Because every bicycle was new and extremely fast.
Because the old machines had trouble but still finished like heroes.
Because no rider entered the race at all.
Because the museum gave everyone a modern racing bike.
questions.explanation_zh: 结尾说 each old machine had finished like a hero。旧车慢、会坏，但能完成比赛，所以 no less exciting。

writing.intro_zh: 今天抓五个 Lesson 56 的旧车比赛高价值句式：用 Once a year, ... is held 写定期活动，用 a great deal of 写不可数情绪，用 Built in ..., ... 写物品背景，用 spent more time ... than ... 写喜剧对比，最后用 very different from ... but no less exciting 写“不同但同样精彩”。

patterns.title: Once a year, ... is held
patterns.source: Once a year, a race is held for old cars.
patterns.focus_zh: 这个句式用被动语态写定期举行的活动，重点是活动本身，不是谁组织。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写一个每年举行一次的比赛、展览、表演或校园活动。
patterns.sample: Once a year, a small bike race is held in the museum yard.
patterns.tip_zh: Once a year 放句首；is held 前面的主语应该是 event，如 a race, a show, a festival。

patterns.title: a great deal of ...
patterns.source: There was a great deal of excitement just before it began.
patterns.focus_zh: a great deal of 后面常接不可数名词，适合写 excitement、pleasure、noise、trouble 等整体感觉或数量。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写比赛、表演或展示开始前有很多兴奋、快乐或麻烦。
patterns.sample: There was a great deal of excitement before the old bikes started.
patterns.tip_zh: 不要写 a great deal of cars；cars 可数，应该用 many 或 a lot of。

patterns.title: Built in ..., ...
patterns.source: Built in 1885, it was the oldest car taking part.
patterns.focus_zh: Built in... 放在句首，可以用很紧凑的方式交代一件物品的年代或背景。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写一辆车、一辆自行车、一个模型或一件展品的制造年代，并说明它有什么特别之处。
patterns.sample: Built in 1902, the black bicycle was the oldest one taking part.
patterns.tip_zh: Built in 后面接年份；逗号后面要接完整句子，说明这个物品。

patterns.title: spent more time ... than ...
patterns.source: Some drivers spent more time under their cars than in them.
patterns.focus_zh: 这个比较句能写出喜剧效果：本来应该做 A，结果花更多时间做 B。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写某人在比赛、手工或准备活动中，花在修理、寻找或整理上的时间比真正行动还多。
patterns.sample: One rider spent more time fixing his chain than riding his old bicycle.
patterns.tip_zh: more time 后面接 doing；than 后面也尽量用同样结构，让比较更整齐。

patterns.title: very different from ... but no less exciting
patterns.source: It was very different from modern car races but no less exciting.
patterns.focus_zh: 这个句式很适合写比较：先承认两件事不同，再说明后者一点也不差、同样精彩。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：比较一个旧式活动和现代活动，说明它们不同但同样令人兴奋。
patterns.sample: The old bike race was very different from modern races but no less exciting.
patterns.tip_zh: no less exciting 表示 just as exciting，不是 less exciting；不要把意思写反。
